notes.title: Issue With Touch Screen Display Players
notes.content:
Greetings Dwellers!

We have detected an issue where players with touch-screen PCs are unable to interact with any buttons upon launching the game. This issue persists regardless if the user is interacting with mouse, controller or touch.

This issue is currently being solved, but extensive testing is still required before a patch goes live. For now, [u][b]please disable touch screen or disconnect your touch screen device and run the game.[/b][/u]

If any other issues persist, please join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/JrK9yBP]Discord[/url] and get in touch. We appreciate all the feedback and effort to help us improve the game!

Love,
PTG Team

notes.title: Region Format Issue
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's been made known to us that there is an issue with the game to stop progressing due to regional format, and we are actively working to fix.

In the meantime, here is a temporary solution:
[olist]
[*] Go to your [b]PC Settings > Time & Language > Language[/b] (column on the left)
[*] Within the [b]Language[/b] tab, under the [b]Preferred Languages[/b] settings, add [b]English[/b] as a preferred language.
[*] Next, go to [b]Region[/b] (column on the left) and change the [b]Regional Format[/b] to [b]English[/b].
[/olist]
Once you have done the above, the game should function as intended.

Once again, thank you for informing us on this issue. Do let us know if there's any more issues regarding regional formats and languages. 

We hope you enjoy the demo.

notes.title: Let Love Burn
notes.content:
Hello Dwellers!

If you believe that the person you love the most may be the one who burns you, then look no further. Fires At Midnight is a cinematic and interactive visual novel with layered storytelling about a couple who struggles to stay together.


As Andreas of Virtual SEA describes:  

"[i]Fires At Midnight creates one of the most believable portrayals of a love relationship we've ever seen in a video game[/i]" - [url=https://virtualseasia.com/2020/07/11/fires-at-midnight-burning-desire-for-gripping-and-innovative-storytelling/]Virtual SEA[/url]


Enjoy the trip back to 1999. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1282140/Fires_At_Midnight/
